result:
PR opened: https://github.com/FChecklist/projexa/pull/51

Summary of what was delivered:
- Real client-side pivot table + bar/line/pie charts over `report_definitions` results, wired into both existing Reports surfaces as new view-mode tabs (Table/Pivot/Chart), alongside the original renderers.
- All aggregation is pure client-side math (`pivot-utils.ts`, unit-tested), zero DB/aggregation logic added to PROJEXA — grep-verified.
- Adopted PROJEXA's own pre-existing but unused shadcn/Recharts wrapper rather than duplicating it; fixed its chart color tokens, which failed the dataviz skill's validator and had no dark-mode variant.
- Generic date-range + key/value filter controls, since `report_definitions` has no formal parameter schema to derive dropdowns from (verified against compliance-tracker's code).
- `tsc --noEmit` and `bun test src` clean.
- Found a real, pre-existing production issue: `projexa-ai.com/login` currently serves compliance-tracker's login UI instead of PROJEXA's, which blocked live-browser E2E verification in this sandbox. As a substitute, I called the real report-execution dispatcher directly against production data for one report each in Sales, Construction, and Interior Design, and confirmed the pivot/chart math against that real data. The E2E test is written and ready but unexecuted pending that routing fix (documented in `ai-os/PIVOT_CHART_TECH_DECISION_2026-07-27.md` and `PROGRESS.md`).
